b) Reference: cherry tomatoes (3 cm) are visible. The plate spans roughly 9-10 tomato lengths across the visible width (about 27-30 cm). Reconciling the two cues gives a width of about 26 cm.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: The meat mound hides its base; the greens and sauce are already counted. No extra layer beyond these.
